sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Actually viewed native and nearest4: woman turned slightly toward screen left with level serious closed-mouth gaze; dark brown brushed-back hair, rolled curled ends at both jaw sides, separate brown brows, clean upper lip/chin. Tall blue-grey asymmetrically tilted fedora with broad pale grey folded V band; blue-grey broad pointed-lapel coat and large round dark center button encircled by pale gold/grey rim at chest. Preserve hat tilt/visible hair and coat style, crop including hat top and upper chest, soft upper-left light and complete dark grey vignette backing; widen the original collar to fit short broad mascot throat. Tiny button relief and band seam detail unreadable.

Standalone full painted rectangle.
